facts.fact: ICT Minister Sofiane Hmissi told Erem Business the government is currently preparing a national strategy for artificial intelligence.

TUN.note: Startups' AI solutions mentioned in general; no model, dataset or AI computing stated.
Digital sovereignty is an axis of a strategy being drafted, but no plan, rule or hosting for state data is stated.

facts.fact: Minister Hmissi says the government is preparing the National Digital Economy Strategy 2026-2030 (Tunisie numerique 2030) within the Tunisia 2030 national development plan, on five axes including public service digitalisation and digital sovereignty.
Minister Hmissi says Tunisia had a 2021-2025 digital strategy, which has ended and is being evaluated while the 2030 document is drawn up.
